The '''Gate''' is a [[Crafting#Fences|craftable]] item that allows players and farm [[animals]] to pass through fences. It lasts for 360 days.

==Gifting==
{{GiftsByItem
|dislike=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus
}}

==Notes==
*Despite being only one block wide, it is still possible to ride a [[Animals#Horse|horse]] through any orientation of gate in any direction.
*Breaking the gate with a [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]] does not destroy it, so you can break it and immediately replace it the day before it degrades.
*A gate can replace a placed fence piece by selecting the gate in inventory and clicking on the fence piece. If surrounded by other [[Stone Fence]] or [[Hardwood Fence]] pieces, the gate will take on the color of the fence instead of the normal dark brown color.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Two gates can now be placed next to each other, allowing for double-width gates.}}
{{History|1.6|Fixed gates popping off when opening or closing them while the player overlaps the tile.}}
